verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is published under an open license is a fair question for any software or SaaS platform, including a card-issuing service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Adyen Issuing's source being available under an open license. The docs cover only hosted APIs, the Customer Area, webhooks and SDK usage, with no mention of source availability or licensing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
